title: Equity in STI Testing Act
latestAction: Referred to the Subcommittee on Health.
summary:
Equity in STI Testing Act

This bill provides for coverage, without cost-sharing, of testing for certain sexually transmitted infections under Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP), TRICARE, Department of Veterans Affairs health benefits, and the Indian Health Service.
